title: ECS task definition rejected: deploy role may not pass the new task role
description: Squash-merged PR #512 lets orders-api consume an SQS queue: infra/ecs.tf adds an IAM task role (aws_iam_role.orders_task, named orders-task-role) with an SQS policy and sets task_role_arn on the task definition. The push-to-main `deploy` run fails in `Terraform apply`: the role and its inline policy are created, then RegisterTaskDefinition fails with AccessDeniedException because the OIDC deploy role gha-deploy is not authorized to perform iam:PassRole on orders-task-role. infra/bootstrap/github-oidc.tf (applied by an admin, not CI) shows why: gha-deploy may create and edit roles matching orders-*, but its PassRole statement only lists orders-api-execution. PR plans use the read-only gha-plan role and `terraform plan` never calls PassRole, so the gap only shows at apply. The right answer is cloud_auth: grant gha-deploy iam:PassRole on orders-task-role (scoped with iam:PassedToService = ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com) in the bootstrap stack and re-run; the application code is not at fault. The AWS provider's deprecated-attribute warning for data.aws_region.current.name is a red herring. No fixPath is required because the policy may be managed outside this repository.

+import asyncio
+import json
+import logging
+
+import boto3
+
+from app import fulfilment
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class OrderEventConsumer:
+    """Long-polls the order-events queue and applies each event to its order."""
+
+    def __init__(self, queue_url: str, *, batch_size: int = 10, client=None) -> None:
+        self._queue_url = queue_url
+        self._batch_size = batch_size
+        self._sqs = client or boto3.client("sqs")
+        self._stopping = asyncio.Event()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self._stopping.set()
+
+    async def run(self) -> None:
+        while not self._stopping.is_set():
+            response = await asyncio.to_thread(
+                self._sqs.receive_message,
+                QueueUrl=self._queue_url,
+                MaxNumberOfMessages=self._batch_size,
+                WaitTimeSeconds=20,
+            )
+            for message in response.get("Messages", []):
+                await self._handle(message)
+
+    async def _handle(self, message: dict) -> None:
+        event = json.loads(message["Body"])
+        try:
+            await fulfilment.apply_event(event)
+        except fulfilment.UnknownOrder:
+            logger.warning("dropping event for unknown order %s", event.get("order_id"))
+        await asyncio.to_thread(
+            self._sqs.delete_message,
+            QueueUrl=self._queue_url,
+            ReceiptHandle=message["ReceiptHandle"],
+        )

+import json
+
+import boto3
+import pytest
+from moto import mock_aws
+
+from app import fulfilment
+from app.consumer import OrderEventConsumer
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def sqs():
+    with mock_aws():
+        client = boto3.client("sqs", region_name="eu-west-1")
+        url = client.create_queue(QueueName="order-events")["QueueUrl"]
+        yield client, url
+
+
+async def test_handled_messages_are_deleted(sqs, monkeypatch):
+    client, url = sqs
+    applied = []
+
+    async def fake_apply(event):
+        applied.append(event["order_id"])
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fulfilment, "apply_event", fake_apply)
+    body = {"order_id": "ord_123", "status": "shipped", "occurred_at": "2026-11-18T10:00:00Z"}
+    client.send_message(QueueUrl=url, MessageBody=json.dumps(body))
+    message = client.receive_message(QueueUrl=url)["Messages"][0]
+
+    await OrderEventConsumer(url, client=client)._handle(message)
+
+    assert applied == ["ord_123"]
+    attributes = client.get_queue_attributes(
+        QueueUrl=url, AttributeNames=["ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible"]
+    )["Attributes"]
+    assert attributes["ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible"] == "0"
+
+
+async def test_unknown_orders_are_dropped(sqs, monkeypatch):
+    client, url = sqs
+
+    async def unknown(event):
+        raise fulfilment.UnknownOrder(event["order_id"])
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fulfilment, "apply_event", unknown)
+    client.send_message(QueueUrl=url, MessageBody=json.dumps({"order_id": "ord_missing"}))
+    message = client.receive_message(QueueUrl=url)["Messages"][0]
+
+    await OrderEventConsumer(url, client=client)._handle(message)
